findings.claim: Objectives o1 and o3 require writing pytest tests and using raises, a fixture and parametrize. Learners only run existing tests, click lines in an existing failure report and recognize a parametrize snippet in an MCQ. The page can reach 100% without authoring a test or using any of the three pytest constructs.
findings.recommendation: Add a bounded test-file editing task that requires one plain assert and completion of supplied raises, fixture and parametrize scaffolds; use lesson-scoped checks and the existing report reader for feedback.

findings.claim: The topic records modeledWorstPath 12.59, which is P50 9.59 plus 3.00 minutes, not the captain-required P50 + 2.00 exactly. The page remains below the 15-minute ceiling, but its timing record and About label are not based on the approved model.
findings.recommendation: Set modeledWorstPath to 11.59, rewrite minutes.basis to state the exact +2.00 model, and recompute budget/aboutLabel as ceil(max(P50, modeledWorstPath)) without changing estimator inputs.
